server.notes: Peregrine ZTP workers use this; toggle from the /ztp page header or edit this file.

pixie.description: Pixiecore ProxyDHCP (--dhcp-no-bind) alongside dnsmasq: PXE offers without binding DHCP port; disable your router DHCP on this segment for Peregrine to own leases.

pulse.description: Post-IP: observe ARP/DHCP for new MACs on the same L2 segment.

step_in.description: Pre-IP: DHCP step-in for PXE; same L2 as clients; may race your LAN router — disable router DHCP or isolate this VLAN so Peregrine dnsmasq owns addresses.
